attributes.description: Pulse oximetry and heart-rate sensor, I2C
nRF52832 BLE module with chip antenna

attributes.clause: Project-defined demo check; not a regulatory clause
attributes.rationale: The mock architecture models a USB-C sink using one 5.1 kOhm pull-down from each CC pin to ground. This checks the stated demo topology and mock values only.

nodes.label: USB input fuse and TVS topology

attributes.clause: Project-defined demo check; not a regulatory clause
attributes.rationale: Checks the mock's intended series-fuse and VBUS-to-ground TVS connections. It does not verify fuse coordination, TVS suitability, surge performance, creepage, or system-level ESD.

nodes.label: Charger input, battery, programming, and return connections

attributes.clause: Project-defined demo check; not a regulatory clause
attributes.rationale: Checks the charger and programming-resistor topology encoded in the mock. It does not calculate charge current, validate thermal dissipation, or establish safe charging for a specific cell.

nodes.label: Battery connector and charger share the battery rail

attributes.clause: Project-defined demo check; not a regulatory clause
attributes.rationale: Checks the battery connections in the mock. It does not assert that a cell is present, protected, correctly polarized, or safe to charge.

nodes.label: 3.3 V regulator feeds the MCU rail

attributes.clause: Project-defined demo check; not a regulatory clause
attributes.rationale: Checks the mock's 3.3 V rail structure using the mock pin map. Confirm the actual module pin names and electrical limits against manufacturer documentation before board release.

nodes.label: 1.8 V sensor rail is regulator-fed and grounded

attributes.clause: Project-defined demo check; not a regulatory clause
attributes.rationale: Checks the intended sensor-supply topology in the mock only. It does not check rail tolerance, transient behavior, dropout, current capacity, or MAX30102 manufacturer limits.

nodes.label: I2C pull-ups connect SDA and SCL to 3.3 V

attributes.clause: Project-defined demo check; not a regulatory clause
attributes.rationale: Checks the mock's intended shared I2C bus and pull-up placement/value. It does not calculate rise time, bus capacitance, sink current, or compatibility with the selected devices.

nodes.label: Charge indicator LED has a series resistor

attributes.clause: Project-defined demo check; not a regulatory clause
attributes.rationale: Checks the mock's current-limited charge-status LED topology. It does not validate LED current, indicator polarity, visibility, or charger STAT pin electrical limits.

nodes.label: Debug header carries SWD, reset, supply, and ground

attributes.clause: Project-defined demo check; not a regulatory clause
attributes.rationale: Checks the debug interface wiring in the mock. Confirm the actual module pin names and electrical levels against manufacturer documentation before board release.
